title: What crosses the device boundary
caption: Local-only learning sends nothing, centralized learning uploads raw observations, and federated learning downloads a shared model then uploads updates. Keeping raw data local reduces one exposure but does not by itself make the update private.
alt: Three lanes comparing local-only, centralized and federated learning across a dashed device boundary

title: Training memory amplifier
caption: The chapter's 10M-parameter example: 40 MB weights plus 40 MB gradients, 80 MB Adam state and 200 MB activations make a 360 MB full-update working set, beyond the 200-300 MB background allowance.
alt: Stacked memory bar showing weights gradients optimizer and activations compared with background allowance

title: Freeze the matrix, train the thin path
caption: For a 768 by 768 layer, rank-4 LoRA trains 6,144 parameters instead of 589,824. The trainable artifact shrinks by 99 percent, while backward traversal, activations and adapter optimizer state remain in the budget.
alt: Large frozen matrix beside thin low-rank trainable projections

title: The aggregate learns the admitted population
caption: Eligibility, sampling, over-selection, deadlines and dropout filter the deployed fleet into completed updates. Coverage ratio compares each cohort's share of completed updates with its share of the deployed population.
alt: Funnel from deployed fleet to admitted devices selected cohort and completed updates with coverage-ratio definition
